review_method: Independent original map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, fresh independently registered outlines, wider context, endpoint detail, imprint and credits. All 163 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with freshly reopened complete source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins; minimum stage is 2 for all three. The successful retained original-body receipt was rechecked against the original bytes. The original primary viewport, projected coordinate system and full-precision GPTS/LPTS controls were reopened. A separately fitted full six-parameter EPSG:26914 affine retains both cross terms and explicitly handles original MediaBox/CropBox offsets. All 163 placements agree with fresh GDAL registration within 0.000001 PDF point; maximum original-control residual is below 0.01 PDF point, measuring affine consistency rather than shoreline accuracy. Six detail/context, three endpoint and one imprint/credit pixel arrays match fresh PDF renders. First original-pixel observations preceded source-research comparison. Original white water and colored geological land were distinguished before final conclusions. Three full-feature source-scope reviews are complete, supporting three generalized identities. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
